memo_json.description: Output contract for the Agenda Intelligence MCP `analyze` tool. Structured strategic-risk memo with evidence discipline: facts, assessments, assumptions, and unknowns are separated; scenarios carry probability ranges; recommended actions carry triggers and time horizons; audit metadata records validation score, provenance, and which reasoning modules were loaded. Reasoning content comes from Global Think Tank Analyst (method) and any activated vertical specialist (regional depth).

assessments: Illustrative assessment: Local-bank de-risking is likely to continue through 2026.
assumptions: No new in-region primary sanctions designation in the planning horizon.
facts: Illustrative fact: OFAC has issued multiple Central Asia-relevant secondary-sanctions advisories.
unknowns: Specific OFAC enforcement priorities for FY2026.

provenance.claim: Local-bank de-risking is likely to continue through 2026.

decision_frame.decision: Open USD correspondent banking relationship in Almaty in Q3.

failure_modes.mitigation: Diversify correspondent candidates; maintain EUR fallback.
failure_modes.scenario: New OFAC secondary-sanctions designation affecting a Kazakh tier-1 bank.

options.option: Proceed with USD correspondent in Q3 under enhanced controls.

recommended_actions.action: Commission a dedicated sanctions controls review before correspondent onboarding.

risk_summary.detailed: Illustrative example. The structural risk centers on USD-clearing dependencies and counterparty exposure to Russian-nexus flows. Material drivers include OFAC enforcement posture, regional bank de-risking, and KZT/USD corridor stress. Mitigation requires explicit sanctions controls, conservative counterparty selection, and pre-cleared correspondent design.

implications: Correspondent relationship feasible with standard controls.
scenarios.name: Baseline

watch_next.trigger: Any new advisory naming Kazakhstan banks

assessments.description: Analyst inference from facts, explicitly labeled.

assumptions.description: Premises the analysis depends on, surfaced for the reader.

facts.description: Established, reported, cited, or user-provided information.

unknowns.description: What the analyst cannot determine with the available context.

machine_verified.description: True when validation_score and validation_details were written by the server, not by the model. The `analyze` tool sets this to true automatically before returning the memo.

source.description: Free-form source reference if available; absent in reasoning_only mode.

reasoning_memory.description: Server-selected AnalysisBank reasoning-memory trace. These entries are reusable reasoning guardrails, not factual evidence, source support, legal advice, or live verification.

self_assessed_score.description: Optional. The model's own self-graded validation_score, preserved here for transparency when the server overwrites validation_score with machine-verified value.

validation_score.description: Structural validation score. When `machine_verified` is true, this value is computed by the Agenda Intelligence server from observable checks (schema validity, fact/assessment separation, unknowns acknowledged, modules match routing, etc.) and is NOT the model's self-grade. Structural only — no claim about factual correctness.

gtta_version.description: Version of the Global Think Tank Analyst reasoning method used.

module.description: Identifier of the SKILL.md or method file loaded into the system prompt (e.g. `global-think-tank-analyst`, `central-asia-caspian`, `gulf-middle-east`).

version.description: Version or commit hash of the bundled module, if known.

trigger.description: Condition under which this action becomes appropriate.

source_type.description: Free-form descriptor of the kind of source to monitor (e.g. `regulator_announcement`, `central_bank_release`, `port_traffic_data`). Use the project source-taxonomy.json for canonical types where applicable.

trigger.description: Threshold or event that would change the view.
